    Transport of rigid structures to Kronecker modules #

    An anchored family over an index type J is an anchor brick C, pairwise orthogonal bricks B j orthogonal to C, and non-split classes. Gluing gives the fully rigid family F_S (S ⊆ J, KroneckerBricks/ExtensionOrth.lean). For a vector space G with subspaces G_j (j ∈ J), the Kronecker module H = ∑_j G_j ⊗ F_{{j}} ⊆ G ⊗ F_J is the transport. Morphisms between transports are Ψ ⊗ id with Ψ(G_j) ⊆ G'_j (Bricks.Anchored.hom_transport, when some G_{j₀} = G); so the transport of a rigid structure is a brick (Bricks.Anchored.isBrick_transport). This is Göbel–Simson, Theorem 3.3, Step 3, for the algebra k.
